name: Le Meridien Barcelona
insider_take: This sleek waterfront sanctuary puts you steps from Barcelona's golden beaches while keeping the Gothic Quarter's medieval magic within easy reach.
whats_special: Le Meridien Barcelona occupies a prime spot on La Rambla, just 200 meters from the Mediterranean Sea. The hotel's rooftop terrace offers stunning views of both the Barcelona skyline and coastline. Originally built as the Hotel Manila in 1956, it was completely renovated to blend mid-century modern design with contemporary luxury. The location places you at the intersection of the historic Barrio Gótico and the vibrant Port Vell marina district.
pro_tip: Book a room on the upper floors facing the sea - you'll wake up to Mediterranean sunrise views and can spot the iconic Columbus Monument from your window.
dont_miss: The hotel sits mere blocks from the famous Boqueria Market, where locals have shopped for fresh produce since 1217. Take the short walk to Barceloneta Beach for morning jogs along the promenade, or explore the nearby Palau Sant Jordi. The Drassanes Metro station is practically at your doorstep, connecting you to Gaudí's masterpieces in under 15 minutes.
pros: Prime location on famous Las Ramblas boulevard
Modern luxury design with artistic French elegance
Exceptional rooftop terrace with panoramic city views
Walking distance to Gothic Quarter and major attractions
cons: Las Ramblas location can be busy and touristy
Premium pricing for central Barcelona location
